latency_scope: Head forward and backward through CUDA synchronization; maximum rank-local elapsed time per aligned iteration. Barriers, memory sampling and digest capture are outside the timer.
host_scope: Host submit and synchronization wait of the same slowest rank selected for each integrated interval. Synchronization wait includes work still running on the device.
memory_scope: Maximum GIFT total GPU memory estimate across timed iterations and ranks
verified_receipt_fields: eight assigned GPU UUIDs, fresh worker PIDs and torchrun rendezvous IDs
matched capture, source, compilation, candidate binaries and flags by route
native NCCL gather count and per-rank pointer arithmetic
native FP32 SUM reduce-scatter and retained sharded gradient
zero timed allocator retries or OOMs
